# `aitbc trade sync`

Sync trading data for a chain and service type.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade sync [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Sync specific chain (default: all chains) |
| `--service-type` | text | — | no | Sync specific service type |
| `--force` | flag | `false` | no | Force sync even if offers are fresh |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade sync
```
